title: Second Sitting of 2nd Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/2/2/2025).
Approval of the minutes of five previous sittings (minutes Nos. 28/1/2025 to 32/1/2025).
Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the bill submitted on behalf of the government by Dhaandhoo MP Mohamed Fazeel to amend Law No. 2/2012 (Maldives Civil Aviation Authority Act).
Foreign Relations Committee report on the President's submission to appoint a non-resident ambassador of the Maldives to Nepal.

Judiciary Committee report on the President's submission under Article 148(a) of the Constitution to appoint Al-Ustaz Abdulla Hameed (Nooraaneemaage, N. Henbadhoo) and Al-Ustaz Mohamed Saleem (Morningvilla, F. Bilehdhoo) as Justices of the Supreme Court.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting approved old minutes, continued debating the Civil Aviation Authority Act amendment and took committee reports on an ambassador nominee for Nepal and two Supreme Court justice nominees.
